title: Onboarding Question on Quilted Leather
whatItIs: A top-down shot of a phone lying on a grey-taupe tufted leather sofa showing a blush onboarding screen with rust-coloured question text, a step indicator, a blue-to-orange gradient arc and Write and Let's talk buttons.
whatItMeans: Warm blush and rust tones match the soft leather, and the gradient arc is a gentle friendly focal point.
techniques: Gradient arc rising from the base
Window light shadows across the sofa

vocabulary.definition: Small dashes showing progress in a flow.
A button allowing the user to talk instead of type.
